ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If the brown trout population increases, what will most likely happen to the mayfly nymph population?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, Brown trout is located at the top, and Mayfly nymph is located on the left side. A green arrow points from Mayfly nymph to Brown trout, indicating that brown trout will feed on mayfly nymph. Reasoning: If the number of brown trout increases, they, as predators, will eat more mayfly nymph. Therefore, the population size of mayfly nymph will most likely decrease.
